name: @rheged-studio/skill-send-it
description: Agent skill: the all-in-one ship pipeline — bundle uncommitted work into atomic commits, run the change-gated lint preflight, author or update the dated changelog entry, compose a Conventional Commits PR title, push, open or update a PR, transition linked Linear issues to In Review, then chain into triage-pr (CI fix, promote-on-green, Phase B) up to the human envelope. Stopping at an open draft is incomplete unless --skip-triage / triage: false was used with a stated reason.
